page.notes: Several readings are doubtful: "amufsim" (the line break shows no hyphen, so "amussim" is likely); the Greek in "experientia cur ἀμέθοδος" and the number "56[?]" after "ciuilis alijs ceu administris utitur" are uncertain; "2 9" may be 29; "115" may be 715. The printed page number is absent: only the signature FF 2 is printed. The "doctrina" ligature and the long s are normalised.
